note: Transponder (Mode A) codes -> meaning. 'range' entries cover a block. US conventions (FAA JO 7110.66); 'level': emergency / special / vfr / normal.

codes.label: DRONE LOST LINK
codes.meaning: Unmanned aircraft lost its control link

codes.label: VFR
codes.meaning: Flying VFR, not receiving ATC services

codes.label: Glider
codes.meaning: VFR glider, not in contact with ATC

codes.label: ADIZ, no contact
codes.meaning: Penetrating an ADIZ without ATC contact

codes.label: Military
codes.meaning: Military aircraft in warning / restricted areas

codes.label: Interceptor
codes.meaning: Military interceptor on an active air-defence mission

codes.label: Invalid
codes.meaning: Not a valid assignment (often a transponder fault)

codes.label: High-altitude special
codes.meaning: Reserved for special high-altitude flights (above FL600)
